text: I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity here. The first scene, with its glass-walled meeting room and the faint aura of professionalism, sparks thoughts about knowledge sharing and collaboration. The second scene shifts me into the vibrant embrace of innovative spirit—colored walls marked R+D, displays, and artifacts of human creativity. Standing within these spaces, I sense a blend of contemplation and excitement, as if I am on the edge between structured learning and boundless experimental inquiry. Being here, I want to pause, observe, and let the energies of both discipline and innovation spark questions within me.
